title: Visit to the Pantex pits

tellings.quote: and and I've been in Pantex. I've been down in the pits.

plain: In the 1980s, John S. Herrington, who was US Secretary of Energy, went down into the pits at Pantex, the Texas plant where America's nuclear weapons are put together. He tells Michels about it himself: "I've been in Pantex. I've been down in the pits." He brings it up to show how close he got to the most secret parts of the nuclear program.
